top_inconsistencies.description: Pack E labels 386/500 items (77.2%) as Remember while every other pack labels 0.2-8.0% as Remember. All 6 Pack E sections are Remember-dominant (Section F: 100% Remember). Pack E treats definition-recall and standard-application both as Remember where Packs A-D label them Understand and Apply.
top_inconsistencies.title: Pack E: 77.2% Remember vs. 1-8% in other packs -- fundamentally different CL taxonomy

summary: CRITICAL FINDINGS: (1) Pack E uses a fundamentally different CL taxonomy: 77.2% Remember vs. 0.2-8.0% in other packs. (2) Pack A Section E has 62.7% Evaluate (168 of 223 total Evaluate assignments pool-wide). (3) Section E (Internal Controls) has 4 different dominant CL labels across 4 packs. (4) 168/223 Evaluate items (75.3%) labeled Easy -- violates DCS v1.0 which requires Moderate+ for Evaluate. (5) Zero items pool-wide labeled Very Difficult.
